body:
As someone who cares about electing Democrats, I need to share this with you...
#
Good morning, Peter. Eugene Vindman here.
I recently had to make one of the toughest decisions I've faced this election year, and as someone who cares about the stakes of this election, I need to explain what it and why I made the choice.
When we recently wrapped up the primary for Virginia’s 7th district in Congress, Republicans chose a MAGA nominee to take me on. Since then, **my opponent has been firing attacks at me non-stop. He even went as far as to call me a “traitor.”**
My team and I quickly came together to determine our strategy moving forward. And our best option was to urgently expand our digital advertising and outreach efforts to fend off the attacks and show voters the truth.
The money wasn’t immediately in the budget, but I gave my team the all clear anyway.
I approved the expense because we can’t let my opponent’s attacks go unanswered and because it’s what we need to do in order to compete against the floods of MAGA mega-donor and super PAC money National Republicans are going to pummel me with. I’m already a top target for Trump since blowing the whistle on him 7 years ago. He’s already launched a sham investigation into me to kick me out of Congress, so his allies are going to spend any amount to flip this seat and get me out of Congress.
This decision was a risk, but one I was willing to take, because I’m betting on this grassroots team to help us fill the budget gap. That’s how much faith I have in this team and our pro-democracy movement.
So, on the heels of my difficult budget decision, I’m asking:
[**Can you please contribute $5, $10, or whatever you can afford to my campaign for Congress? We can close this budget gap quickly and win if everyone chips in.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/evfc-em-sep26?refcode=em260906-av&refcode2=1097_3892029_QpHe-N&akid=1097%2E3892029%2EQpHe-N)

* Build the resources needed to compete against national Republican spending

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: Texans deserve a governor who’s going to fight for their healthcare
body:
Greg Abbott knew this was coming.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
**Peter, Texas hospitals are losing $27 million _a day_ in critical Medicaid funding.**
[****](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260906_1_medicaid.z_UsWc&refcode=em20260906-2025&amount=5&t=1&akid=2025%2E299639%2E_TtyB5)
**That’s nearly $10 billion stripped from our healthcare safety net this year alone.**
It means emergency rooms facing major budget cuts, pediatric specialty care will be delayed, and clinics across the state will shut down. **Most of all, this impacts the 4 million Texans enrolled in Medicaid — the vast majority of whom are children.**
**The most infuriating thing about this is that Greg Abbott _knew_ this was coming.**
This collapse didn't happen overnight. This impasse has been dragging on quietly in the background since last December. For over nine months, as hospital leadership has been sounding the alarm, Greg Abbott dragged on taking action. Now, the money has run out, and millions of Texas families are paying the price for his dysfunction.
**I can’t stress this enough. We absolutely can’t afford a governor who sleeps through warning signs while children lose access to healthcare.**
Texans deserve a governor who is on the ball from day one. Someone who will fight relentlessly for our families, protect our local hospitals, and ensure every Texan can get the healthcare they need.
**[Will you chip in $5 right now to help us reach voters across Texas and elect a governor who will actually fight for your healthcare?](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260906_1_medicaid.z_UsWc&refcode=em20260906-2025&amount=5&t=2&akid=2025%2E299639%2E_TtyB5)**
[Donate $5 »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20260906_1_medicaid.z_UsWc&amount=5&refcode=em20260906-2025&t=21&akid=2025%2E299639%2E_TtyB5)
Thank you,
Gina
